name: apexflow-project-crm
description: Enterprise Project & Client CRM Suite with zero external API dependencies

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=path.join('.',req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url.split('?')[0]);if(!fs.existsSync(f)){res.writeHead(404);return res.end('Not Found');}let ext=path.extname(f);let ct={'html':'text/html','css':'text/css','js':'application/javascript','json':'application/json'}[ext.slice(1)]||'text/plain';res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':ct});fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(res);}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('CRM Server running at http://localhost:8080'));"

author: ApexFlow Technologies
